spec.description: Optimize import from Zeebe: stalls, lag, throughput and errors per record type and partition
Now minus the time up to which a record reader has imported everything Zeebe exported. Grows while a record reader is stalled or can't keep up.
spec.title: Import lag by partition

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (RECORD_TYPE, le) (rate(optimize_import_overallImportTime_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", RECORD_TYPE=~"$record_type", PARTITION_ID=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (RECORD_TYPE, le) (rate(optimize_import_overallImportTime_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", RECORD_TYPE=~"$record_type", PARTITION_ID=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.description: Time from Zeebe creating a record to Optimize storing it, for records imported in the window. Only covers imported records, so a stalled record reader shows no data here: use 'Import lag' for that.
spec.title: Record import latency p50 / p99

spec.description: Optimize only fetches the intents it needs for some record types (e.g. PROCESS_INSTANCE), so for those its rate stays below Zeebe's even when caught up. For VARIABLE both rates match when caught up.
spec.title: Records imported / s vs exported by Zeebe / s

spec.description: The page size each record reader currently fetches with. Records per page at the maximum means there is a backlog.
spec.title: Fetch page size vs configured maximum

spec.expr: sum by (RECORD_TYPE) (rate(optimize_import_newPageFetchTime_seconds_sum{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", RECORD_TYPE=~"$record_type", PARTITION_ID=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (RECORD_TYPE) (rate(optimize_import_newPageFetchTime_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", RECORD_TYPE=~"$record_type", PARTITION_ID=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: Querying the zeebe-record indices, including empty polls.
spec.title: Fetch time per page (mean)

spec.expr: sum by (RECORD_TYPE) (rate(optimize_import_indexingDuration_seconds_sum{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", RECORD_TYPE=~"$record_type", PARTITION_ID=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (RECORD_TYPE) (rate(optimize_import_indexingDuration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", RECORD_TYPE=~"$record_type", PARTITION_ID=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: Writing a page to Optimize's indices, including the time spent retrying failed writes.
spec.title: Write time per page (mean)

spec.expr: sum by (RECORD_TYPE) (rate(optimize_import_cycleDuration_seconds_sum{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", RECORD_TYPE=~"$record_type", PARTITION_ID=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (RECORD_TYPE) (rate(optimize_import_cycleDuration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", RECORD_TYPE=~"$record_type", PARTITION_ID=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: A full import cycle: fetch and write, including empty cycles.
spec.title: Cycle time (mean)

spec.expr: count by (RECORD_TYPE) (sum by (RECORD_TYPE, PARTITION_ID) (rate(optimize_import_cycleDuration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", RECORD_TYPE=~"$record_type", PARTITION_ID=~"$partition"}[2m])) == 0) or on() vector(0)

spec.description: Record readers (one per record type and partition) that completed no import cycle in the last 2 minutes. An idle record reader still completes an empty cycle at least every ~30s, so this only counts record readers that are stuck, e.g. on a database write that keeps failing (see 'Failed database writes').
spec.title: Stalled record readers

spec.description: Fetches that found no zeebe-record index of a record type. Expected for record types Zeebe hasn't exported yet, e.g. AGENT_INSTANCE when no AI agents are used.
spec.title: Zeebe index missing / s

spec.description: Errors across Optimize, including failed import writes, REST requests and report evaluations.
spec.title: Errors by type / s

spec.description: Documents not imported because they exceeded the nested document limit, e.g. instances with very many variables. Only happens with import.skipDataAfterNestedDocLimitReached enabled, and that data is missing from Optimize.
spec.title: Documents skipped at nested limit / s

spec.expr: sum by (RECORD_TYPE, ERROR_TYPE) (increase(optimize_import_dbWriteFailures_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", RECORD_TYPE=~"$record_type", PARTITION_ID=~"$partition"}[5m])) or on() vector(0)

spec.description: Failed attempts to write an imported page to Optimize's indices. A failed page is retried until it succeeds, so the record reader makes no progress while this is increasing. ERROR_TYPE tells why the write failed.
spec.title: Failed database writes (5m)

spec.description: How far Optimize's data is behind what Zeebe has exported. Keeps growing while a record reader is stalled, and stays below ~30s for an idle record reader that is caught up.
spec.title: Import lag (worst partition)

spec.description: Fraction of time the busiest record reader of each record type spends importing. A record reader imports one page at a time, so close to 100% means it can't import any faster and lag grows if Zeebe keeps exporting at that rate.
spec.title: Record reader busy fraction

spec.expr: max by (namespace) (optimize_import_configuredPartitions{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) - on (namespace) count by (namespace) (count by (namespace, partition) (atomix_role{namespace=~"$namespace"}))

spec.description: Partitions Optimize is configured to import (zeebe.partitionCount, default 1) minus Zeebe partitions, per namespace. Below 0 means some partitions are never imported. Needs the Zeebe broker metrics in the same Prometheus.
spec.title: Configured vs Zeebe partitions

spec.expr: sum by (RECORD_TYPE) (increase(optimize_import_zeebeIndexMissing_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", RECORD_TYPE=~"PROCESS|PROCESS_INSTANCE", PARTITION_ID=~"$partition"}[15m])) or on() vector(0)

spec.description: Fetches that found no zeebe-record index of processes or process instances to read from, e.g. because of a wrong index prefix (zeebe.name) or the exporter not running. Expected only before Zeebe exported its first records. Indices of other record types only exist once such records are exported, see 'Zeebe index missing / s'.
spec.title: Zeebe process index missing (15m)

spec.expr: count by (RECORD_TYPE) (optimize_import_fetchPageSize{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", RECORD_TYPE=~"$record_type", PARTITION_ID=~"$partition"} < on(namespace, pod) group_left max by (namespace, pod) (optimize_import_maxPageSize{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})) or on() vector(0)

spec.description: Record readers fetching with a smaller page than configured. Optimize halves the page size after a failed fetch and only restores it gradually, so imports stay slower for a while after an Elasticsearch/OpenSearch problem.
spec.title: Fetch page size reduced

spec.description: Errors while fetching or mapping a page. The page is skipped and fetched again in the next cycle.
spec.title: Record reader errors (15m)
Health: is any record reader stalled, failing or saturated?
Lag: how far behind Zeebe is Optimize?
